name: inprocess-obi-apb3-ahb-tlul-three-protocol-f1f4
description: One Ibex RVFI OBI CPU reaches three register targets of three different protocols in one process: the PULP APB3 timer at 0x40001000, the unmodified Caliptra sha256_ctrl AHB-Lite target at 0x40000000 and the OpenTitan TL-UL rv_timer at 0x40003000. Every target states its own protocol from its own artifact, the host samples each target's own trace (psel/penable/pready, the two AHB phases, and the A/D channels), and each case states the protocol of the target it was routed to.
notes: target0 is the PULP timer behind the real apb3_mmio_bridge (profile protocol apb/3) at 0x40001000, target1 is the Caliptra sha256_ctrl behind ahb_lite_mmio_target (profile protocol ahb-lite/1) at 0x40000000, and target2 is the OpenTitan rv_timer behind beat_to_tlul (profile protocol tl-ul/1) at 0x40003000
the three windows are the profiles' own 4 KiB windows and do not overlap each other or the RAM image 0x10000..0x30000
the sha case writes BLOCK2 (0x88, write-only) and then reads STATUS (0x18), so the AHB target case line states both phases of a real write followed by both phases of a real read
no target declares an IRQ behavior, so F5 is refused by name in this session and no F5 record is admitted
no DMA is declared, so F6 is refused as unsupported-f6:no-dma-model:APB+AHB-Lite+TL-UL
